name: Steak by Reel and Rustic
address: 124a York St, George Central, George, 6530, South Africa
description_short: Perfectly grilled steaks in George's historic town centre, where quality meat meets laid-back hospitality.
description_long:
Tucked away on York Street in George's central business district, Steak by Reel and Rustic brings a refreshingly straightforward approach to serious steak. The focus here is squarely on quality cuts, expertly prepared and served without fuss in a relaxed atmosphere that feels more neighbourhood gathering spot than formal steakhouse.

The menu celebrates proper meat cookery, with steaks grilled to order and complemented by thoughtful sides. It's the kind of place where the staff know their way around a ribeye and aren't afraid to offer honest recommendations. The mid-range pricing makes it accessible for a regular Tuesday night as much as a weekend celebration.

Located in the heart of George, it's an easy stop whether you're exploring the town's Victorian architecture or just passing through the Garden Route. The genuine warmth of service and consistent quality have earned it a loyal local following, with visitors quickly understanding why regulars keep coming back.
